subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted as an explicit openclaw skills lint workflow first, or must normal skills list, skills check, gateway status, and Web UI also surface skipped candidates before this issue can close?
rationale: Current code has no diagnostic surface, and the open PR is a plausible implementation path but narrower than the issue's requested normal visibility across CLI and Web surfaces.

options.title: Keep issue open for full diagnostic surface
options.body: Use the lint PR as a step, but require normal status/list/check/Web visibility or a linked follow-up before closing this issue.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land or repair the lint PR as the first product surface and keep this issue or a follow-up open for broader status/UI diagnostics.

options.title: Declare lint-only sufficient
options.body: Close this issue after a correct lint implementation, explicitly ruling normal list/status/Web warnings out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Keep issue open for full diagnostic surface
recommendation.body: Use the lint PR as a step, but require normal status/list/check/Web visibility or a linked follow-up before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame places the current loader/status/parser implementation on vincentkoc, making them the best available routing owner for the core diagnostic-surface decision.
